purpose: Review-only skeletal deformation, independent-rifle attachment, and two-hand contact proof for approved grip candidate A before locomotion or production frame expansion.
camera: measured orthographic gameplay camera pitched downward exactly 45 degrees
facing: twelve real 30-degree yaw samples for each of READY, MOVE, and FIRE
lighting: neutral diagnostic body material, orange independent rifle, controlled cyan rim, and restrained contact markers
prompt: No generated imagery is used in this rig stage. Build a non-destructive eight-bone review skeleton over the approved body GLB, preserve the complete source topology, compute continuous four-slot torso and arm skin weights, attach the approved separate rifle GLB through BoneAttachment3D to firing_hand, and solve both arm chains to the locked candidate-A pistol-grip and medium-forward handguard anchors while preserving stock-to-shoulder contact.
negative_constraints: no 2D weapon rotation, fused body-and-rifle mesh, one-handed grip, floating stock, or manual front-behind sprite swap
no rigid one-bone arm regions, stretched spikes, deleted-arm holes, proxy-sphere limbs, or underweighted dangling vertices
no claim that neutral materials are production texture or that MOVE includes a locomotion leg cycle
no Player.gd change, production atlas replacement, 120-frame expansion, or gameplay integration before approval

references.role: approved fused body geometry and complete topology

generation_model: Godot 4.7 Skeleton3D, generated Skin, continuous four-weight regions, analytic two-bone arm solving, BoneAttachment3D, and deterministic SubViewport rendering
